ImageNet-Paste
	

ImageNet-Paste is created by pasting in small images of different concepts into each image from the ImageNet validation dataset to probe the impact of concept pairs on multimodal task accuracy in natural images.


Each ImageNet validation image is augmented by pasting in a small image of a different concept (accessory_word), and models are tasked with producing the correct ImageNet classification in the presence of the other concept.
